messages:
maya: Started a repro for the new q30b-int4v2 bring-up. Seeing a consistent context-anchor undershoot after ~15.7k tokens. Not an obvious off-by-one, looks like the KV index jumps to 0 when RoPE wraps.
ravi: Can you share the logs/artifact?
maya: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/1770012345/logs.tar.gz — the kv index dump and posscale trace are in there.
maya: KV dump snippet: ```KV_INDEX: 15872\nROTARY_POS: 15872\nROT_WRAP: true\nKV_SLOT: 0 -> collision\n```
olivia: :eyes: that jump on wrap is concerning. Happens on which quantization profile?
maya: only on int4-hybrid profile. int8 and float32 don't show it.
samuel: smells like quant rounding + stride math in prefill. Could be negative offset truncation.
kevin: did you try turning off dynamic windowing?
maya: yes — dynamic_window=false removes the repro. dynamic=true triggers it every run.
ravi: queue a sweep to vary window sizes and stride values.
ci-bot: Job queued: https://ci.redwood/jobs/anchor-undershoot-sweep-1770012345 (matrix: window=[8k,16k,32k], stride=[64,128,256], quant=[int4v2,int8])
olivia: hypothesis: quantized kernel does integer truncation when rotary wrap yields negative index -> undershoot to slot 0.
samuel: can we add an assert in kv_handshake: `assert(kv_idx >= 0 && kv_idx < window_size)` and fail early to catch it?
maya: good call. I'm pushing a tiny patch to add bounds checks + extra telemetry for last_prefill_token and last_prefill_offset.
maya: patch pushed: https://git.redwood/repo/changes/PR-5428
ci-bot: Job started: anchor-undershoot-sweep-1770012345/1
kevin: also add shard-aware logging — if this happens cross-shard it could explain the flake we saw with context stitching.
ravi: agree; add a flag so we can enable telemetry on canary only. Don't flood prod.
olivia: while you have it instrumented, please run the priority goldset eval to get quality numbers pre/post patch.
samuel: plan: baseline float -> int4 no-patch -> int4 with-patch on 1k long-context prompts. Compare perplexity + token-flip rate.
maya: running evals now, will post numbers here.
maya: Baseline (float32) perplexity on goldset: 12.2
maya: int4 without patch: 18.9 (clear degradation)
maya: int4 with bounds-check patch + telemetry: 12.4 (nearly restored)
kevin: that's pretty convincing. Patch fixes the regression.
ravi: prepare a PR description documenting the root cause hypothesis and the mitigations (bounds checks + opt-in telemetry + canary rollout).
maya: writing PR notes now and will include repro gist and CI matrix results.
olivia: do we need a backport to stable release branch?
kevin: yes — this affects production canary profiles. Backport to stable and schedule a small canary on dedicated.
samuel: also add an automated unit test that simulates rotary wrap + quantized kernel math; should catch regressions in CI.
maya: adding unit test to PR.
ci-bot: Sweep finished: all matrix jobs passed except int4v2 @ window=16k stride=64 which reproduced. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/anchor-undershoot-sweep-1770012345/results
ravi: good info. That specific config is the narrow window where offset rounding is worst.
olivia: for rollout, block Dedicated capacity upgrade until we run canary on traffic slice.\eolivia: (typo) for rollout, block Dedicated capacity upgrade until we run canary on traffic slice.
maya: noted — I'll ping eng-sre and schedule a canary for tomorrow.
samuel: once canary is green, add telemetry to long-term dashboards so we can spot recurrence.
kevin: thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks team, will follow up with PR link and canary schedule. :rocket:
